CustomField.description: THE FAMILY THIS CONTRACT IS READ UNDER, declared by the contract rather than inferred from its code. Written by: the contract seeders. Read by: AAO_LocateCharter.familyOf, which groups the declared set into families for the read and the run report. It exists so ADDING A FAMILY IS A DATA ACT, NOT AN APEX EDIT: familyOf used to be a hardcoded prefix ladder that THREW on any code it did not recognise, so the first Problems or Politics contract minted would have failed call 1 outright for every family at once. Blank falls back to that ladder, so every contract seeded before this field existed keeps its family and nothing has to be migrated in a hurry. This is routing, never charter content: it says which read a question travels in, and says nothing about what the question asks.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Which family this contract is read under (for example Buyer Role, Political Status, Decision criteria, Sentiment). Set it when minting a contract in a new family. Blank falls back to the legacy code-prefix mapping.
CustomField.label: Family
